text.value:
/* pl_raw_orch_init > Script "Ins_master_run"
   (v8.3 개정 3, adf_script_v83_master_ins_init.sql 기반)

   Master PENDING 등록
   (+ REQUEST 는 재수집 요청 확보)

   진입 방식 :

     A. INIT_LOAD

        A-1. p_init_load_group 값 있음
             -> ctl_ingest_target_master.init_load_group = p_init_load_group
             -> init_wait_yn = 'Y' 대상만 수집

        A-2. p_init_load_group NULL
             -> init_wait_yn = 'N' 대상만 수집

        단, p_run_group_nm 이 없고 p_request_yn <> 'Y' 인 경우
        INIT_LOAD 진입으로 판단

     B. FULL_REFRESH / PARTIAL_REFRESH

        p_run_group_nm 값 있음
        -> RAW_REFRESH Run Group 경유

        p_run_type_override = PARTIAL_REFRESH
           -> PARTIAL_REFRESH

        그 외
           -> FULL_REFRESH

     C. REQUEST

        p_request_yn = 'Y'
        -> PENDING 재수집 요청 확보

   진입 방식은 정확히 하나만 허용

   검증 실패 :
     형변환 오류로 활동 실패
     Master 행 생성 안 됨

   같은 master_run_id 재실행 시 무시
     ON CONFLICT (master_run_id) DO NOTHING

   Trigger명 :
     p_trigger_nm 우선

   p_entry_run_id :
     entry_run_id 에 기록

   ADF 동적 식은 p 에만 사용.
   주석은 블록 주석만 사용
*/

WITH p AS (
    SELECT
        '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text
            AS master_run_id,

        '@{pipeline().Pipeline}'::text
            AS pipeline_nm,

        NULLIF(
            trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_init_load_group}'),
            ''
        )
            AS init_load_group,

        NULLIF(
            trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_group_nm}'),
            ''
        )
            AS run_group_nm,

        upper(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_request_yn}'),
                    ''
                ),
                'N'
            )
        ) = 'Y'
            AS request_yn,

        NULLIF(
            trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_scheduled_time}'),
            ''
        )::timestamptz
            AS scheduled_dt,

        NULLIF(
            trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_target_ids}'),
            ''
        )::jsonb
            AS target_ids,

        upper(
            NULLIF(
                trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_type_override}'),
                ''
            )
        )
            AS run_type_override,

        '@{pipeline().TriggerType}'::text
            AS trigger_type,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_trigger_nm}'),
                ''
            ),
            NULLIF(
                '@{pipeline().TriggerName}',
                ''
            ),
            'Manual'
        )
            AS trigger_nm,

        NULLIF(
            trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_entry_run_id}'),
            ''
        )
            AS entry_run_id,

        '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text
            AS created_by
),

/* ================================================================
   진입 방식 판정

   INIT_LOAD :
     p_run_group_nm IS NULL
     AND p_request_yn <> Y

   p_init_load_group 은 INIT_LOAD 내부의 선택 조건이며
   값이 없어도 INIT_LOAD 진입 가능

   충돌 예 :
     p_init_load_group + p_run_group_nm
     p_init_load_group + REQUEST
     p_run_group_nm + REQUEST
   ================================================================ */
e AS (
    SELECT
        p.*,

        (
            (
                p.init_load_group IS NOT NULL

                OR (
                    p.run_group_nm IS NULL
                    AND NOT p.request_yn
                )
            )::int

            + (p.run_group_nm IS NOT NULL)::int

            + p.request_yn::int

        ) AS entry_cnt

    FROM p
),

/* ================================================================
   A. INIT_LOAD

   p_init_load_group 값 있음 :
     init_load_group 일치
     AND init_wait_yn = 'Y'

   p_init_load_group NULL :
     init_wait_yn = 'N'

   target_ids 지정 시 해당 Target 존재 여부까지 검증
   ================================================================ */
ga AS (
    SELECT
        e.*

    FROM e

    WHERE e.entry_cnt = 1

      AND e.run_group_nm IS NULL

      AND NOT e.request_yn

      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1

          FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m

          WHERE m.delete_yn = 'N'

            AND (
                    (
                        e.init_load_group IS NOT NULL

                        AND m.init_load_group = e.init_load_group

                        AND upper(
                                COALESCE(
                                    NULLIF(
                                        trim(m.init_wait_yn),
                                        ''
                                    ),
                                    'N'
                                )
                            ) = 'Y'
                    )

                    OR

                    (
                        e.init_load_group IS NULL

                        AND upper(
                                COALESCE(
                                    NULLIF(
                                        trim(m.init_wait_yn),
                                        ''
                                    ),
                                    'N'
                                )
                            ) = 'N'
                    )
                )

            AND (
                    e.target_ids IS NULL

                    OR m.target_id IN (
                        SELECT
                            jsonb_array_elements_text(
                                e.target_ids
                            )::bigint
                    )
                )
      )
),

/* ================================================================
   B. FULL_REFRESH / PARTIAL_REFRESH

   p_run_group_nm 을 받으면 RAW_REFRESH 그룹으로 실행

   p_run_type_override = PARTIAL_REFRESH
     -> PARTIAL_REFRESH

   그 외
     -> FULL_REFRESH
   ================================================================ */
gb AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        g.run_group_id

    FROM e

    JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_run_group g
      ON g.run_group_nm = e.run_group_nm
     AND g.enabled_yn = 'Y'
     AND g.job_type_cd = 'RAW_REFRESH'

    WHERE e.entry_cnt = 1

      AND e.run_group_nm IS NOT NULL

      AND NOT e.request_yn

      AND e.init_load_group IS NULL
),

/* ================================================================
   C. REQUEST
   ================================================================ */
gc AS (
    SELECT
        e.*

    FROM e

    WHERE e.entry_cnt = 1

      AND e.request_yn

      AND e.run_group_nm IS NULL

      AND e.init_load_group IS NULL
),

/* 확보할 PENDING 요청 */
req AS (
    SELECT
        q.request_id

    FROM adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q

    JOIN gc
      ON TRUE

    WHERE q.status = 'PENDING'

      AND q.refresh_type_cd = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'

      AND (
              gc.target_ids IS NULL

              OR q.target_id IN (
                  SELECT
                      jsonb_array_elements_text(
                          gc.target_ids
                      )::bigint
              )
          )
),

/* ================================================================
   Master PENDING 등록
   ================================================================ */
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
    (
        master_run_id,
        master_pipeline_nm,
        trigger_type_cd,
        adf_trigger_nm,
        scheduled_dt,

        run_group_id,
        init_load_group,
        run_type_override_cd,
        run_param,

        entry_run_id,

        status,
        created_by
    )

    /* --------------------------------------------------------------
       A. INIT_LOAD

       init_load_group 값 있음
         -> init_wait_yn = Y 대상

       init_load_group NULL
         -> init_wait_yn = N 대상

       run_param 에 init_wait_yn 도 기록
       -------------------------------------------------------------- */
    SELECT
        ga.master_run_id,
        ga.pipeline_nm,

        'INIT_LOAD',

        ga.trigger_nm,
        ga.scheduled_dt,

        NULL,

        ga.init_load_group,

        NULL,

        jsonb_strip_nulls(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'init_load_group',
                ga.init_load_group,

                'init_wait_yn',
                CASE
                    WHEN ga.init_load_group IS NOT NULL
                        THEN 'Y'
                    ELSE
                        'N'
                END,

                'target_ids',
                ga.target_ids
            )
        ),

        ga.entry_run_id,

        'PENDING',
        ga.created_by

    FROM ga

    UNION ALL

    /* --------------------------------------------------------------
       B. FULL_REFRESH / PARTIAL_REFRESH
       -------------------------------------------------------------- */
    SELECT
        gb.master_run_id,
        gb.pipeline_nm,

        CASE
            WHEN gb.trigger_type = 'Manual'
                THEN 'MANUAL'
            ELSE
                'SCHEDULE'
        END,

        gb.trigger_nm,
        gb.scheduled_dt,

        gb.run_group_id,

        NULL,

        CASE
            WHEN gb.run_type_override = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'
                THEN 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'
        END,

        jsonb_strip_nulls(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'target_ids',
                gb.target_ids,

                'run_type_override',
                CASE
                    WHEN gb.run_type_override = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'
                        THEN 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'
                    ELSE
                        'FULL_REFRESH'
                END
            )
        ),

        gb.entry_run_id,

        'PENDING',
        gb.created_by

    FROM gb

    UNION ALL

    /* --------------------------------------------------------------
       C. REQUEST
       -------------------------------------------------------------- */
    SELECT
        gc.master_run_id,
        gc.pipeline_nm,

        CASE
            WHEN gc.trigger_type = 'Manual'
                THEN 'MANUAL'
            ELSE
                'SCHEDULE'
        END,

        gc.trigger_nm,
        gc.scheduled_dt,

        NULL,
        NULL,

        'REQUEST',

        jsonb_strip_nulls(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'request',
                true,

                'target_ids',
                gc.target_ids,

                'request_cnt',
                (
                    SELECT count(*)
                    FROM req
                )
            )
        ),

        gc.entry_run_id,

        'PENDING',
        gc.created_by

    FROM gc

    ON CONFLICT (master_run_id)
    DO NOTHING

    RETURNING
        master_run_id,
        trigger_type_cd,
        adf_trigger_nm,
        run_group_id,
        init_load_group,
        run_type_override_cd,
        run_param,
        status
),

/* ================================================================
   C. 요청 확보
   Master 가 새로 등록된 경우만

   동시 실행 시 다른 실행이 먼저 확보한 요청 제외
   ================================================================ */
claim AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q

       SET status = 'RUNNING',

           master_run_id = i.master_run_id,

           updated_by = (
               SELECT created_by
               FROM p
           ),

           updated_dt = now()

      FROM ins i

     WHERE i.run_type_override_cd = 'REQUEST'

       AND q.request_id IN (
           SELECT request_id
           FROM req
       )

       AND q.status = 'PENDING'

    RETURNING
        q.request_id
)

/* ================================================================
   결과
   ================================================================ */
SELECT
    i.master_run_id,
    i.trigger_type_cd,
    i.adf_trigger_nm,
    i.run_group_id,
    i.init_load_group,
    i.run_type_override_cd,

    i.run_param::text
        AS run_param,

    i.status,

    (
        SELECT count(*)
        FROM claim
    ) AS request_cnt,

    /* 검증 실패
       -> 형변환 오류로 활동 실패
       -> Master 행 생성 안 됨
    */
    CASE
        WHEN (
            SELECT entry_cnt
            FROM e
        ) <> 1

            THEN (
                'ENTRY_PARAM_INVALID:'
                ||
                (
                    SELECT
                        COALESCE(init_load_group, '')
                        || '/'
                        || COALESCE(run_group_nm, '')
                        || '/'
                        || request_yn::text
                    FROM p
                )
            )::int

        /* INIT_LOAD 대상 없음
           - 그룹 지정 시 init_wait_yn = Y 대상 없음
           - 그룹 미지정 시 init_wait_yn = N 대상 없음
        */
        WHEN (
                SELECT run_group_nm
                FROM p
             ) IS NULL

         AND NOT (
                SELECT request_yn
                FROM p
             )

         AND (
                SELECT count(*)
                FROM ga
             ) = 0

            THEN (
                CASE
                    WHEN (
                        SELECT init_load_group
                        FROM p
                    ) IS NOT NULL

                        THEN
                            'INIT_LOAD_GROUP_OR_WAIT_TARGET_NOT_FOUND:'
                            || (
                                SELECT init_load_group
                                FROM p
                            )

                    ELSE
                        'INIT_LOAD_READY_TARGET_NOT_FOUND:init_wait_yn=N'
                END
            )::int

        WHEN (
                SELECT run_group_nm
                FROM p
             ) IS NOT NULL

         AND (
                SELECT count(*)
                FROM gb
             ) = 0

            THEN (
                'RUN_GROUP_NOT_FOUND_OR_NOT_REFRESH:'
                || (
                    SELECT run_group_nm
                    FROM p
                )
            )::int

        ELSE
            1

    END AS chk

FROM (
    SELECT 1
) d

LEFT JOIN ins i
  ON TRUE;

activities.name: Exec_run_check
activities.description: BIZDAY 판정 / 전역 skip / Trigger 이력. SKIP 이면 Master = SKIPPED

text.value:
/* Fail_master_run_check : Exec_run_check 실패 시. Master 는 PENDING -> FAILED */
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
   SET status          = 'FAILED',
       child_total_cnt = 0,
       child_succ_cnt  = 0,
       child_fail_cnt  = 0,
       error_log       = left('[Exec_run_check] '
                              || '@{replace(activity('Exec_run_check').error.message, '''', '''''')}', 4000),
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
 WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING');

/* Prepare_src_lookup : 원천조회(PART) 가 필요한 Target 과 조회 쿼리. init.sql 의 파티션 값 결정 중 LOOKUP_ALL / LOOKUP_FROM 에 해당하는 대상만
     LOOKUP_ALL  : FULL_REFRESH + partition_clause 있음 (원천조회 전체), INIT_LOAD 에서 목록(partition_val 원소 1개 이상) · 변수 목록 · 시작+끝 이 모두 없는 경우
     LOOKUP_FROM / LOOKUP_TO : 시작값만 / 끝값만(INIT_LOAD 만) 지정한 경우. REQUEST 제외
   Master 가 PENDING 이 아니면 (SKIPPED 등) 0건. 조회 위치 = 추출 위치 (cdc_tgt_* 우선)
   ADF 동적 식은 p 에만 사용. 주석은 블록 주석만 사용 */
WITH p AS (
    SELECT '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text                           AS master_run_id,
           NULLIF(trim('@{variables('pv_start_val')}'), '')      AS start_in,
           NULLIF(trim('@{variables('pv_end_val')}'), '')        AS end_in,
           NULLIF(NULLIF(regexp_replace('@{variables('pv_partition_val')}', '\s', '', 'g'), ''), '[]')::jsonb AS list_in
),
master_src AS (
    SELECT m.master_run_id, m.run_group_id, m.init_load_group,
           m.run_param -> 'target_ids' AS target_ids,
           (m.run_type_override_cd = 'REQUEST') IS TRUE AS req_yn,
           CASE WHEN m.run_type_override_cd = 'REQUEST'  THEN 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'
                WHEN m.run_type_override_cd IS NOT NULL THEN m.run_type_override_cd
                WHEN m.init_load_group      IS NOT NULL THEN 'INIT_LOAD'
                ELSE 'FULL_REFRESH' END AS run_type_cd
      FROM adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
      JOIN p ON p.master_run_id = m.master_run_id
     WHERE m.status = 'PENDING'
),
target_src AS (
    SELECT m.target_id, r.run_type_cd
      FROM master_src r
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m
        ON m.init_load_group = r.init_load_group AND m.delete_yn = 'N'
     WHERE r.run_type_cd = 'INIT_LOAD'
       AND (r.target_ids IS NULL OR m.target_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(r.target_ids)::bigint))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.target_id, r.run_type_cd
      FROM master_src r
      JOIN adfadm.vw_ingest_exec_target e
        ON e.run_group_id = r.run_group_id AND e.run_type_cd = 'FULL_REFRESH'
     WHERE r.run_type_cd <> 'INIT_LOAD' AND NOT r.req_yn
       AND (r.target_ids IS NULL OR e.target_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(r.target_ids)::bigint))
),
d AS (
    SELECT t.run_type_cd, m.target_id, m.src_type,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(m.cdc_tgt_db_nm), ''),     m.src_db_nm)     AS ext_db_nm,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm), ''), m.src_schema_nm) AS ext_schema_nm,
           m.src_table_nm, m.partition_clause,
           m.partition_clause ->> 'partition_column' AS part_col,
           m.partition_clause -> 'partition_val'     AS part_list
      FROM target_src t
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m ON m.target_id = t.target_id
)
SELECT d.target_id, d.ext_db_nm, d.ext_schema_nm, d.src_type, d.part_col,
       'SELECT DISTINCT ' || d.part_col || ' AS LOOKUP_VAL FROM ' || d.ext_schema_nm || '.' || d.src_table_nm
       || CASE upper(d.src_type) WHEN 'DB2' THEN ' WITH UR' WHEN 'MSSQL' THEN ' WITH (NOLOCK)' ELSE '' END AS lookup_query
  FROM d CROSS JOIN p
 WHERE d.partition_clause IS NOT NULL AND d.part_col IS NOT NULL
   AND (   d.run_type_cd = 'FULL_REFRESH'
        /* INIT_LOAD : 목록(원소 1개 이상) / 변수 목록 / 시작 + 끝 이 아니면 원천조회 (시작값만 / 끝값만 / 없음) */
        OR (    d.run_type_cd = 'INIT_LOAD'
            AND NOT (jsonb_typeof(d.part_list) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(d.part_list) >= 1)
            AND p.list_in IS NULL
            AND NOT (p.start_in IS NOT NULL AND p.end_in IS NOT NULL))
        /* PARTIAL_REFRESH : 시작값만 지정한 경우 */
        OR (    d.run_type_cd = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'
            AND p.list_in IS NULL AND p.start_in IS NOT NULL AND p.end_in IS NULL))
 ORDER BY d.target_id;

/* Fail_master_run_prepare : Prepare_src_lookup 실패 시. Master 는 PENDING -> FAILED */
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
   SET status          = 'FAILED',
       child_total_cnt = 0,
       child_succ_cnt  = 0,
       child_fail_cnt  = 0,
       error_log       = left('[Prepare_src_lookup] '
                              || '@{replace(activity('Prepare_src_lookup').error.message, '''', '''''')}', 4000),
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
 WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING');

/* Ins_src_lookup : 원천조회 결과 -> ctl_ingest_src_lookup (PART). 같은 (master_run_id, target_id) 는 지우고 다시 적재 (재시도 대비)
   LOOKUP_VAL 이 없는(null) 행 = 원천 NULL 파티션 */
WITH p AS (
    SELECT '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text        AS master_run_id,
           @{item().target_id}::bigint         AS target_id,
           '@{replace(string(activity('Lkp_src_part_MLIWT').output.value), '''', '''''')}'::jsonb AS vals,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text   AS created_by
),
del AS (
    DELETE FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_src_lookup l
     USING p
     WHERE l.master_run_id = p.master_run_id AND l.target_id = p.target_id AND l.lookup_type_cd = 'PART'
)
INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_ingest_src_lookup (master_run_id, target_id, lookup_type_cd, lookup_val, created_by)
SELECT p.master_run_id, p.target_id, 'PART', rtrim(e ->> 'LOOKUP_VAL'), p.created_by
  FROM p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.vals) e;

text.value:
/* pl_raw_orch_init > Script "Start_ingest_pipeline Script" (v8.3 개정 6, adf_script_v83_init.sql)

   INIT_LOAD / FULL_REFRESH / PARTIAL_REFRESH / REQUEST 수집 이력 생성
   (파티션 1개 = 1행).
   Master 가 PENDING 일 때만

   partition_clause :
     partition_column,
     partition_range (DAILY / MONTHLY / YEARLY),
     data_type,
     column_type (선택),
     format,
     partition_val
     (INIT_LOAD 목록, INVALID = 목록 외 + NULL)

   파티션 값 결정 (먼저 맞는 것) :
     파티션 없음(INIT_LOAD / FULL_REFRESH) 전체 1행
     / REQUEST 요청 파티션
     / FULL_REFRESH 원천조회 전체
     / INIT_LOAD 목록 (partition_val 원소 1개 이상)
     / 변수 목록 p_partition_val
     / 시작 + 끝 기간 전개
     / 시작값만 원천조회 중 시작값 이상
     / INIT_LOAD 끝값만 원천조회 중 끝값 이하
     / INIT_LOAD 아무것도 없음
       (partition_val 빈 배열 또는 키 없음 포함) 원천조회 전체

     PARTIAL_REFRESH 는 변수 없으면
     PARTITION_PARAM_MISSING 유지

   파일명 :
     {src_db}.{schema}.{table}.{part}.{ts}.parquet

     part 값이 있으면 실제 파티션 값 사용
       예) 202601, 2026

     파티션이 없는 경우 part 자리에는 default 사용

     NULL 파티션은 NULL 사용

   ★ 변경 : FULL / REFRESH 저장 경로
     Pipeline Parameter : p_frequency_cd
     전달값 : daily / weekly / monthly / hourly

     landing_path 없으면 :
       full/frequency={p_frequency_cd}/batch_datetime={YYYYMMDDHHMI}

     사용자 지정 landing_path 지원 토큰 :
       {frequency}
       {batch_datetime}

   실패 처리 :
     PARTITION_CLAUSE_INVALID:target_id
     PARTITION_PARAM_MISSING:target_id
     (형변환 오류로 Script 실패 -> Master FAILED)

   무시되는 입력
     (우선순위에서 밀린 변수 등)은 오류로 하지 않고
     Master error_log 에 [WARN] 으로 기록
     (수집은 계속, 성공이면 유지,
      실패면 실패 메시지 뒤에 덧붙임)

   Script 재시도 = 0.
   ADF 동적 식은 p 에만 사용.
   주석은 블록 주석만 사용
*/

WITH p AS (
    SELECT
        '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text
            AS master_run_id,

        NULLIF(
            trim('@{variables('pv_start_val')}'),
            ''
        )
            AS start_in,

        NULLIF(
            trim('@{variables('pv_end_val')}'),
            ''
        )
            AS end_in,

        NULLIF(
            NULLIF(
                regexp_replace(
                    '@{variables('pv_partition_val')}',
                    '\s',
                    '',
                    'g'
                ),
                ''
            ),
            '[]'
        )::jsonb
            AS list_in,

        '@{variables('pv_yyyyMMddHHmmss')}'::text
            AS batch_ts,

        /* ★ 변경 : FULL/REFRESH 저장 경로 frequency */
        lower(
            NULLIF(
                trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_frequency_cd}'),
                ''
            )
        )::text
            AS frequency_cd,

        '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text
            AS created_by
),

/* 1. 이번 실행 Master (PENDING 일 때만) */
master_src AS (
    SELECT
        m.master_run_id,
        m.run_group_id,
        m.init_load_group,

        m.run_param -> 'target_ids'
            AS target_ids,

        (m.run_type_override_cd = 'REQUEST') IS TRUE
            AS req_yn,

        CASE
            WHEN m.run_type_override_cd = 'REQUEST'
                THEN 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'

            WHEN m.run_type_override_cd IS NOT NULL
                THEN m.run_type_override_cd

            WHEN m.init_load_group IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'INIT_LOAD'

            ELSE
                'FULL_REFRESH'
        END AS run_type_cd

    FROM adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m

    JOIN p
      ON p.master_run_id = m.master_run_id

    WHERE m.status = 'PENDING'
),

/* 2. 대상 Target */
target_src AS (

    /* INIT_LOAD : 초기수집 그룹 */
    SELECT
        NULL::int4 AS run_group_id,
        NULL::int8 AS run_rule_id,
        m.target_id

    FROM master_src r

    JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m
      ON m.init_load_group = r.init_load_group
     AND m.delete_yn = 'N'

    WHERE r.run_type_cd = 'INIT_LOAD'

      AND (
              r.target_ids IS NULL

              OR m.target_id IN (
                  SELECT
                      jsonb_array_elements_text(
                          r.target_ids
                      )::bigint
              )
          )

    UNION ALL

    /* FULL_REFRESH / PARTIAL_REFRESH : Run Group (RAW_REFRESH) */
    SELECT
        e.run_group_id,
        e.run_rule_id,
        e.target_id

    FROM master_src r

    JOIN adfadm.vw_ingest_exec_target e
      ON e.run_group_id = r.run_group_id
     AND e.run_type_cd = 'FULL_REFRESH'

    WHERE r.run_type_cd <> 'INIT_LOAD'
      AND NOT r.req_yn

      AND (
              r.target_ids IS NULL

              OR e.target_id IN (
                  SELECT
                      jsonb_array_elements_text(
                          r.target_ids
                      )::bigint
              )
          )

      /* 파티션 없는 Target 은 PARTIAL_REFRESH 대상이 아님.
         그룹 전체 실행이면 제외.
         target_id 직접 지정이면 PARTITION_CLAUSE_INVALID
      */
      AND NOT (
          r.run_type_cd = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'
          AND r.target_ids IS NULL
          AND e.partition_clause IS NULL
      )

    UNION ALL

    /* REQUEST :
       이 실행이 확보한 요청의 Target
       같은 Target 요청 여러 건은 1건
    */
    SELECT DISTINCT
        NULL::int4,
        NULL::int8,
        q.target_id

    FROM master_src r

    JOIN adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q
      ON q.master_run_id = r.master_run_id
     AND q.status = 'RUNNING'

    JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m
      ON m.target_id = q.target_id
     AND m.delete_yn = 'N'

    WHERE r.req_yn
),

/* 3. partition_clause 분해 */
part_def AS (
    SELECT
        t.run_group_id,
        t.run_rule_id,
        r.master_run_id,
        r.run_type_cd,
        r.req_yn,
        m.*,

        /* 추출 위치 */
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                trim(m.cdc_tgt_db_nm),
                ''
            ),
            m.src_db_nm
        ) AS ext_db_nm,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                trim(m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm),
                ''
            ),
            m.src_schema_nm
        ) AS ext_schema_nm,

        m.partition_clause ->> 'partition_column'
            AS part_col,

        upper(
            m.partition_clause ->> 'partition_range'
        ) AS part_range,

        upper(
            m.partition_clause ->> 'data_type'
        ) AS part_type,

        upper(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    trim(
                        m.partition_clause ->> 'column_type'
                    ),
                    ''
                ),
                m.partition_clause ->> 'data_type'
            )
        ) AS col_type,

        m.partition_clause ->> 'format'
            AS part_fmt,

        m.partition_clause -> 'partition_val'
            AS part_list

    FROM target_src t

    CROSS JOIN master_src r

    JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m
      ON m.target_id = t.target_id
),

/* 3-1. 설정 검증 + 파티션 값 결정 방식 + 기간 단위 */
part_mode AS (
    SELECT
        d.*,
        p.start_in,
        p.end_in,
        p.list_in,

        /* 범위 조건 여부 :
           날짜 컬럼,
           또는 문자 컬럼(YYYYMM 등 월 이하 형식) + YEARLY
        */
        (
            d.col_type IN ('DATE', 'TIMESTAMP')

            OR (
                d.col_type = 'STRING'
                AND d.part_type = 'STRING'
                AND d.part_range = 'YEARLY'
                AND upper(d.part_fmt) LIKE '%MM%'
            )
        ) AS rng_yn,

        CASE d.part_range
            WHEN 'DAILY'
                THEN 'day'

            WHEN 'YEARLY'
                THEN 'year'

            ELSE
                'month'
        END AS part_unit,

        CASE d.part_range
            WHEN 'DAILY'
                THEN interval '1 day'

            WHEN 'YEARLY'
                THEN interval '1 year'

            ELSE
                interval '1 month'
        END AS part_step,

        CASE
            /* 파티션 없는 Target :
               테이블 전체 1행
               INIT_LOAD / FULL_REFRESH 만
            */
            WHEN d.partition_clause IS NULL
             AND NOT d.req_yn
             AND d.run_type_cd IN (
                    'INIT_LOAD',
                    'FULL_REFRESH'
                 )
                THEN 'NONE'

            WHEN d.part_col IS NULL
              OR d.part_range NOT IN (
                    'DAILY',
                    'MONTHLY',
                    'YEARLY'
                 )
              OR d.part_type NOT IN (
                    'STRING',
                    'NUMERIC',
                    'DATE',
                    'TIMESTAMP'
                 )
              OR d.col_type NOT IN (
                    'STRING',
                    'NUMERIC',
                    'DATE',
                    'TIMESTAMP'
                 )
              OR (
                    d.part_type = 'STRING'
                    AND NULLIF(
                            trim(d.part_fmt),
                            ''
                        ) IS NULL
                 )
              OR (
                    d.col_type IN (
                        'DATE',
                        'TIMESTAMP'
                    )
                    AND d.part_type = 'NUMERIC'
                 )
                THEN (
                    'PARTITION_CLAUSE_INVALID:'
                    || d.target_id
                )::int::text

            WHEN d.req_yn
                THEN 'REQUEST'

            WHEN d.run_type_cd = 'FULL_REFRESH'
                THEN 'LOOKUP_ALL'

            /* INIT_LOAD 목록형 :
               partition_val 원소가 1개 이상일 때만
            */
            WHEN d.run_type_cd = 'INIT_LOAD'
             AND jsonb_typeof(d.part_list) = 'array'
             AND jsonb_array_length(d.part_list) >= 1
                THEN 'JSON_LIST'

            WHEN p.list_in IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'LIST'

            WHEN p.start_in IS NOT NULL
             AND p.end_in IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'RANGE'

            WHEN p.start_in IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'LOOKUP_FROM'

            /* INIT_LOAD 만 :
               끝값만 지정 = 원천조회 중 끝값 이하
            */
            WHEN d.run_type_cd = 'INIT_LOAD'
             AND p.end_in IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'LOOKUP_TO'

            /* INIT_LOAD 아무것도 없음 = 원천조회 전체 */
            WHEN d.run_type_cd = 'INIT_LOAD'
                THEN 'LOOKUP_ALL'

            ELSE
                (
                    'PARTITION_PARAM_MISSING:'
                    || d.target_id
                )::int::text
        END AS part_mode

    FROM part_def d

    CROSS JOIN p
),

/* 4. 파티션 값 목록
   part_kind :
     VAL     값
     INVALID 목록 외
     NULLV   원천 NULL
     NONE    파티션 없음
*/
partition_src AS (

    /* 파티션 없는 Target : 1행 */
    SELECT
        d.target_id,
        NULL::text AS part_val,
        'NONE' AS part_kind

    FROM part_mode d

    WHERE d.part_mode = 'NONE'

    UNION ALL

    /* 재수집 요청의 파티션
       JSON null = NULL 파티션
    */
    SELECT
        d.target_id,
        x,
        CASE
            WHEN x IS NULL
                THEN 'NULLV'

            ELSE
                'VAL'
        END

    FROM part_mode d

    JOIN adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q
      ON q.master_run_id = d.master_run_id
     AND q.target_id = d.target_id
     AND q.status = 'RUNNING'

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL
        jsonb_array_elements_text(
            q.partition_val
        ) x

    WHERE d.part_mode = 'REQUEST'

    UNION ALL

    /* INIT_LOAD JSON 목록 */
    SELECT
        d.target_id,
        x,
        'VAL'

    FROM part_mode d,
         jsonb_array_elements_text(
             d.part_list
         ) x

    WHERE d.part_mode = 'JSON_LIST'
      AND x <> 'INVALID'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        d.target_id,
        'INVALID',
        'INVALID'

    FROM part_mode d

    WHERE d.part_mode = 'JSON_LIST'
      AND d.part_list @> '["INVALID"]'::jsonb

    UNION ALL

    /* 원천조회 값
       FULL_REFRESH 전체 /
       시작값만 준 경우는 5 에서 시작값 이상만
    */
    SELECT
        d.target_id,
        l.lookup_val,

        CASE
            WHEN l.lookup_val IS NULL
                THEN 'NULLV'

            ELSE
                'VAL'
        END

    FROM part_mode d

    JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_src_lookup l
      ON l.master_run_id = d.master_run_id
     AND l.target_id = d.target_id
     AND l.lookup_type_cd = 'PART'

    WHERE d.part_mode = 'LOOKUP_ALL'

       OR (
              d.part_mode IN (
                  'LOOKUP_FROM',
                  'LOOKUP_TO'
              )
          AND l.lookup_val IS NOT NULL
       )

    UNION ALL

    /* 시작 ~ 끝 기간 전개
       YEARLY 문자 값은 앞 4자리 연도로 해석 :
       '2025' / '202501' 모두 2025년
    */
    SELECT
        d.target_id,

        CASE
            WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING'
             AND d.part_range = 'YEARLY'
                THEN to_char(
                    g,
                    'YYYY'
                )

            WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING'
                THEN to_char(
                    g,
                    d.part_fmt
                )

            WHEN d.part_type = 'TIMESTAMP'
                THEN to_char(
                    g,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                )

            ELSE
                to_char(
                    g,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD'
                )
        END,

        'VAL'

    FROM part_mode d,

         generate_series(
             CASE
                 WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING'
                  AND d.part_range = 'YEARLY'
                     THEN to_date(
                         left(d.start_in, 4),
                         'YYYY'
                     )

                 WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING'
                     THEN to_date(
                         d.start_in,
                         d.part_fmt
                     )

                 ELSE
                     d.start_in::date
             END::timestamp,

             CASE
                 WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING'
                  AND d.part_range = 'YEARLY'
                     THEN to_date(
                         left(d.end_in, 4),
                         'YYYY'
                     )

                 WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING'
                     THEN to_date(
                         d.end_in,
                         d.part_fmt
                     )

                 ELSE
                     d.end_in::date
             END::timestamp,

             d.part_step
         ) g

    WHERE d.part_mode = 'RANGE'
      AND d.part_type <> 'NUMERIC'

    UNION ALL

    /* 숫자 : 1씩 증가 */
    SELECT
        d.target_id,
        g::text,
        'VAL'

    FROM part_mode d,

         generate_series(
             d.start_in::bigint,
             d.end_in::bigint
         ) g

    WHERE d.part_mode = 'RANGE'
      AND d.part_type = 'NUMERIC'

    UNION ALL

    /* 변수 목록 */
    SELECT
        d.target_id,
        x,
        'VAL'

    FROM part_mode d,
         jsonb_array_elements_text(
             d.list_in
         ) x

    WHERE d.part_mode = 'LIST'
),

/* 5. 범위 조건 대상 :
   값 -> 기간 시작일.
   같은 기간은 1건으로 합치고,
   파티션 값은 기간 시작일을 다시 표기
   (YEARLY 문자 = YYYY)
*/
partition_val AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        s.target_id,
        s.part_kind,
        k.from_dt,

        CASE
            WHEN k.from_dt IS NULL
                THEN s.part_val

            WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING'
             AND d.part_range = 'YEARLY'
                THEN to_char(
                    k.from_dt,
                    'YYYY'
                )

            WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING'
                THEN to_char(
                    k.from_dt,
                    d.part_fmt
                )

            WHEN d.part_type = 'TIMESTAMP'
                THEN to_char(
                    k.from_dt,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                )

            ELSE
                to_char(
                    k.from_dt,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD'
                )
        END AS part_val

    FROM partition_src s

    JOIN part_mode d
      ON d.target_id = s.target_id

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            CASE
                WHEN d.rng_yn
                 AND s.part_kind = 'VAL'
                    THEN date_trunc(
                        d.part_unit,

                        CASE
                            WHEN s.part_val ~
                                 '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
                                THEN left(
                                    s.part_val,
                                    10
                                )::date

                            WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING'
                             AND d.part_range = 'YEARLY'
                                THEN to_date(
                                    left(
                                        s.part_val,
                                        4
                                    ),
                                    'YYYY'
                                )

                            WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING'
                                THEN to_date(
                                    s.part_val,
                                    d.part_fmt
                                )

                            ELSE
                                s.part_val::date
                        END
                    )
            END AS from_dt,

            /* 시작값
               시작값만 준 경우의 필터용
            */
            CASE
                WHEN d.part_mode = 'LOOKUP_FROM'
                 AND d.rng_yn
                    THEN date_trunc(
                        d.part_unit,

                        CASE
                            WHEN d.start_in ~
                                 '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
                                THEN left(
                                    d.start_in,
                                    10
                                )::date

                            WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING'
                             AND d.part_range = 'YEARLY'
                                THEN to_date(
                                    left(
                                        d.start_in,
                                        4
                                    ),
                                    'YYYY'
                                )

                            WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING'
                                THEN to_date(
                                    d.start_in,
                                    d.part_fmt
                                )

                            ELSE
                                d.start_in::date
                        END
                    )
            END AS start_dt,

            /* 끝값
               INIT_LOAD 끝값만 준 경우의 필터용,
               끝값이 속한 기간까지 포함
            */
            CASE
                WHEN d.part_mode = 'LOOKUP_TO'
                 AND d.rng_yn
                    THEN date_trunc(
                        d.part_unit,

                        CASE
                            WHEN d.end_in ~
                                 '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
                                THEN left(
                                    d.end_in,
                                    10
                                )::date

                            WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING'
                             AND d.part_range = 'YEARLY'
                                THEN to_date(
                                    left(
                                        d.end_in,
                                        4
                                    ),
                                    'YYYY'
                                )

                            WHEN d.part_type = 'STRING'
                                THEN to_date(
                                    d.end_in,
                                    d.part_fmt
                                )

                            ELSE
                                d.end_in::date
                        END
                    )
            END AS end_dt
    ) k

    WHERE
        CASE
            WHEN d.part_mode NOT IN (
                     'LOOKUP_FROM',
                     'LOOKUP_TO'
                 )
                THEN TRUE

            WHEN d.part_mode = 'LOOKUP_FROM'
                THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN d.rng_yn
                            THEN k.from_dt >= k.start_dt

                        WHEN d.part_type = 'NUMERIC'
                            THEN s.part_val::numeric
                                 >= d.start_in::numeric

                        ELSE
                            s.part_val >= d.start_in
                    END

            ELSE
                CASE
                    WHEN d.rng_yn
                        THEN k.from_dt <= k.end_dt

                    WHEN d.part_type = 'NUMERIC'
                        THEN s.part_val::numeric
                             <= d.end_in::numeric

                    ELSE
                        s.part_val <= d.end_in
                END
        END
),

/* 5-1. 기간의 비교 문자열
   시작 이상, 다음 기간 시작 미만
*/
partition_rng AS (
    SELECT
        v.*,

        CASE
            WHEN d.col_type = 'TIMESTAMP'
                THEN to_char(
                    v.from_dt,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD'
                ) || ' 00:00:00'

            WHEN d.col_type = 'STRING'
                THEN to_char(
                    v.from_dt,
                    d.part_fmt
                )

            ELSE
                to_char(
                    v.from_dt,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD'
                )
        END AS from_str,

        CASE
            WHEN d.col_type = 'TIMESTAMP'
                THEN to_char(
                    v.from_dt + d.part_step,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD'
                ) || ' 00:00:00'

            WHEN d.col_type = 'STRING'
                THEN to_char(
                    v.from_dt + d.part_step,
                    d.part_fmt
                )

            ELSE
                to_char(
                    v.from_dt + d.part_step,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD'
                )
        END AS to_str

    FROM partition_val v

    JOIN part_mode d
      ON d.target_id = v.target_id
),

/* 6. WHERE 조건 */
query_src AS (
    SELECT
        d.*,
        v.part_val,
        v.part_kind,

        count(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.target_id
        ) AS part_cnt,

        CASE
            /* 파티션 없음 : 조건 없음 */
            WHEN v.part_kind = 'NONE'
                THEN NULL

            /* 원천 NULL 파티션 */
            WHEN v.part_kind = 'NULLV'
                THEN d.part_col || ' IS NULL'

            /* INVALID :
               범위 조건 -> 목록 기간 밖 + NULL
               목록 값이 없으면 전체 1 = 1
            */
            WHEN v.part_kind = 'INVALID'
             AND d.rng_yn
                THEN COALESCE(
                    '(NOT ('
                    || (
                        SELECT
                            string_agg(
                                '('
                                || d.part_col
                                || ' >= '''
                                || o.from_str
                                || ''' AND '
                                || d.part_col
                                || ' < '''
                                || o.to_str
                                || ''')',
                                ' OR '
                                ORDER BY o.from_dt
                            )

                        FROM partition_rng o

                        WHERE o.target_id = d.target_id
                          AND o.part_kind = 'VAL'
                    )
                    || ') OR '
                    || d.part_col
                    || ' IS NULL)',
                    '1 = 1'
                )

            /* INVALID :
               문자 · 숫자 컬럼 -> 목록 외 값 + NULL
               목록 값이 없으면 전체 1 = 1
            */
            WHEN v.part_kind = 'INVALID'
                THEN COALESCE(
                    '('
                    || d.part_col
                    || ' NOT IN ('
                    || (
                        SELECT
                            string_agg(
                                CASE
                                    WHEN d.col_type = 'NUMERIC'
                                        THEN o.part_val

                                    ELSE
                                        ''''
                                        || o.part_val
                                        || ''''
                                END,
                                ', '
                                ORDER BY o.part_val
                            )

                        FROM partition_rng o

                        WHERE o.target_id = d.target_id
                          AND o.part_kind = 'VAL'
                    )
                    || ') OR '
                    || d.part_col
                    || ' IS NULL)',
                    '1 = 1'
                )

            /* 범위 조건 :
               날짜 컬럼 / 문자 컬럼 + YEARLY
            */
            WHEN d.rng_yn
                THEN
                    d.part_col
                    || ' >= '''
                    || v.from_str
                    || ''' AND '
                    || d.part_col
                    || ' < '''
                    || v.to_str
                    || ''''

            /* 숫자 컬럼 */
            WHEN d.col_type = 'NUMERIC'
                THEN
                    d.part_col
                    || ' = '
                    || v.part_val

            /* 문자 컬럼 */
            ELSE
                d.part_col
                || ' = '''
                || v.part_val
                || ''''
        END AS part_where,

        'pl_'
        || lower(d.data_class)
        || '_ingest_'
        || lower(d.src_type)
        || '_'
        || upper(d.ext_db_nm)
            AS ingest_pipeline_nm

    FROM part_mode d

    JOIN partition_rng v
      ON v.target_id = d.target_id
),

/* 6-1. 무시되는 변수 경고
   오류 아님 :
   Master error_log 에 [WARN] 으로 기록,
   수집은 계속
*/
warn_src AS (
    SELECT
        left(
            concat_ws(
                ' / ',

                (
                    SELECT
                        '[WARN] partition_val 목록이 우선하여 '
                        || 'p_partition_val / p_start_val / p_end_val 무시 : target '
                        || string_agg(
                            d.target_id::text,
                            ','
                            ORDER BY d.target_id
                        )

                    FROM part_mode d

                    WHERE d.part_mode = 'JSON_LIST'
                      AND (
                              d.start_in IS NOT NULL
                           OR d.end_in IS NOT NULL
                           OR d.list_in IS NOT NULL
                      )
                ),

                (
                    SELECT
                        '[WARN] p_partition_val 이 우선하여 '
                        || 'p_start_val / p_end_val 무시 : target '
                        || string_agg(
                            d.target_id::text,
                            ','
                            ORDER BY d.target_id
                        )

                    FROM part_mode d

                    WHERE d.part_mode = 'LIST'
                      AND (
                              d.start_in IS NOT NULL
                           OR d.end_in IS NOT NULL
                      )
                ),

                (
                    SELECT
                        '[WARN] FULL_REFRESH / REQUEST 는 '
                        || 'p_partition_val / p_start_val / p_end_val 을 사용하지 않음 : target '
                        || string_agg(
                            d.target_id::text,
                            ','
                            ORDER BY d.target_id
                        )

                    FROM part_mode d

                    WHERE (
                              d.part_mode = 'REQUEST'
                           OR (
                                  d.part_mode = 'LOOKUP_ALL'
                              AND d.run_type_cd = 'FULL_REFRESH'
                           )
                          )
                      AND (
                              d.start_in IS NOT NULL
                           OR d.end_in IS NOT NULL
                           OR d.list_in IS NOT NULL
                      )
                )
            ),
            1000
        ) AS warn_msg
),

/* 7. Master PENDING -> RUNNING */
mst AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m

       SET status = 'RUNNING',
           start_dt = now(),
           updated_by = p.created_by,
           updated_dt = now(),

           child_total_cnt = (
               SELECT count(*)
               FROM query_src
           ),

           error_log = NULLIF(
               (
                   SELECT warn_msg
                   FROM warn_src
               ),
               ''
           )

      FROM p

     WHERE m.master_run_id = p.master_run_id
       AND m.status = 'PENDING'

    RETURNING
        m.master_run_id
),

/* 7-1. 수집 이력
   파티션 1개 = 1행, PENDING
*/
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
    (
        master_run_id,
        run_group_id,
        run_rule_id,
        target_id,
        ingest_pipeline_nm,
        run_type_cd,

        sink_type_cd,
        load_method_cd,
        range_column_nm,
        range_operator_cd,
        range_value,

        partition_value,
        partition_cnt,

        src_type,
        src_db_nm,
        src_schema_nm,
        src_table_nm,
        cdc_tgt_db_nm,
        cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
        data_class,

        extract_query,
        landing_path,
        file_name,

        status,
        created_by
    )

    SELECT
        p.master_run_id,
        q.run_group_id,
        q.run_rule_id,
        q.target_id,
        q.ingest_pipeline_nm,
        q.run_type_cd,

        q.sink_type_cd,

        /* DBX 적재방식 */
        CASE
            WHEN q.run_type_cd = 'INIT_LOAD'
                THEN NULL

            WHEN q.run_type_cd = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'
                THEN 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'

            ELSE
                'FULL_DELETE_INSERT'
        END,

        /* DBX 범위
           PARTIAL_REFRESH 만 :
           컬럼 IN [파티션값]
        */
        CASE
            WHEN q.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
             AND q.run_type_cd = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'
                THEN q.part_col
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN q.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
             AND q.run_type_cd = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'
                THEN 'IN'
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN q.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
             AND q.run_type_cd = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'
                THEN jsonb_build_array(
                    q.part_val
                )
        END,

        /* 파티션 값 · 수
           파티션 없음 = 둘 다 NULL
        */
        CASE
            WHEN q.part_kind = 'NONE'
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                COALESCE(
                    q.part_val,
                    '(NULL)'
                )
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN q.part_kind = 'NONE'
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                q.part_cnt
        END,

        q.src_type,
        q.src_db_nm,
        q.src_schema_nm,
        q.src_table_nm,

        NULLIF(
            trim(q.cdc_tgt_db_nm),
            ''
        ),

        NULLIF(
            trim(q.cdc_tgt_schema_nm),
            ''
        ),

        q.data_class,

        /* 추출 쿼리 :
           템플릿이 있으면 {WHERE} 치환
           (파티션 없음 = 1 = 1),
           없으면 SELECT *
           (추출 위치 스키마)
        */
        CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(
                    trim(q.src_query_template),
                    ''
                 ) IS NOT NULL

                THEN replace(
                    q.src_query_template,
                    '{WHERE}',
                    COALESCE(
                        q.part_where,
                        '1 = 1'
                    )
                )

            WHEN upper(q.src_type) = 'DB2'
                THEN
                    'SELECT * FROM '
                    || q.ext_schema_nm
                    || '.'
                    || q.src_table_nm
                    || COALESCE(
                           ' WHERE '
                           || q.part_where,
                           ''
                       )
                    || ' WITH UR'

            WHEN upper(q.src_type) = 'MSSQL'
                THEN
                    'SELECT * FROM '
                    || q.ext_schema_nm
                    || '.'
                    || q.src_table_nm
                    || ' WITH (NOLOCK)'
                    || COALESCE(
                           ' WHERE '
                           || q.part_where,
                           ''
                       )

            ELSE
                'SELECT * FROM '
                || q.ext_schema_nm
                || '.'
                || q.src_table_nm
                || COALESCE(
                       ' WHERE '
                       || q.part_where,
                       ''
                   )
        END,

        /* ============================================================
           ★ 변경 : FULL / REFRESH 저장 경로

           기본 :
             full/
               frequency=daily|weekly|monthly|hourly/
                 batch_datetime=YYYYMMDDHHMI/

           사용자 지정 landing_path 지원 토큰 :
             {frequency}
             {batch_datetime}

           더 이상 사용하지 않음 :
             {batch_date}
             {batch_hour}
             {pipeline_nm}
           ============================================================ */
        CASE
            WHEN q.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2'
                THEN NULL

            WHEN NULLIF(
                    trim(q.landing_path),
                    ''
                 ) IS NOT NULL
                THEN replace(
                         replace(
                             q.landing_path,
                             '{frequency}',
                             p.frequency_cd
                         ),
                         '{batch_datetime}',
                         left(
                             p.batch_ts,
                             12
                         )
                     )

            ELSE
                'full'
                || '/frequency='
                || p.frequency_cd
                || '/batch_datetime='
                || left(
                       p.batch_ts,
                       12
                   )
        END,

        /* 파일명 :
           {src_db}.{schema}.{table}.{part}.{ts}.parquet

           part_kind = NONE
             -> default

           실제 파티션 값
             -> part_val
                예) 202601 / 2026

           NULL 파티션
             -> NULL
        */
        CASE
            WHEN q.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2'
                THEN NULL

            WHEN NULLIF(
                    trim(q.file_nm_template),
                    ''
                 ) IS NOT NULL
                THEN replace(
                         replace(
                           replace(
                             replace(
                               replace(
                                 q.file_nm_template,

                                 '{src_db}',
                                 q.src_db_nm
                               ),

                               '{schema}',
                               q.src_schema_nm
                             ),

                             '{table}',
                             q.src_table_nm
                           ),

                           '{part}',
                           CASE
                               WHEN q.part_kind = 'NONE'
                                   THEN 'default'

                               ELSE
                                   COALESCE(
                                       q.part_val,
                                       'NULL'
                                   )
                           END
                         ),

                         '{ts}',
                         p.batch_ts
                     )

            ELSE
                q.src_db_nm
                || '.'
                || q.src_schema_nm
                || '.'
                || q.src_table_nm
                || '.'
                || CASE
                       WHEN q.part_kind = 'NONE'
                           THEN 'default'

                       ELSE
                           COALESCE(
                               q.part_val,
                               'NULL'
                           )
                   END
                || '.'
                || p.batch_ts
                || '.parquet'
        END,

        'PENDING',
        p.created_by

    FROM query_src q

    CROSS JOIN p

    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mst
    )

    RETURNING
        ingest_pipeline_id,
        master_run_id,
        ingest_pipeline_nm,
        run_type_cd,
        extract_query,
        landing_path,
        file_name,

        target_id,
        src_db_nm,
        src_schema_nm,
        src_table_nm,
        cdc_tgt_db_nm,
        cdc_tgt_schema_nm,

        sink_type_cd,
        load_method_cd,
        partition_value,
        partition_cnt,
        status
)

/* ForEach 입력 */
SELECT
    ingest_pipeline_id,
    master_run_id,
    ingest_pipeline_nm,
    extract_query,

    COALESCE(
        landing_path,
        ''
    ) AS landing_path,

    COALESCE(
        file_name,
        ''
    ) AS file_name,

    target_id,
    run_type_cd,

    src_db_nm,
    src_schema_nm,
    src_table_nm,
    cdc_tgt_db_nm,
    cdc_tgt_schema_nm,

    sink_type_cd,
    load_method_cd,
    partition_value,
    partition_cnt,
    status

FROM ins

ORDER BY
    target_id,
    partition_value;

/* End_master_run : ForEach 완료 시 (성공 / 실패 모두). RUNNING 인 Master 만 갱신 (Fail_master_run 이 바꾼 행 · SKIPPED 는 유지)
   종료 시점에 RUNNING / PENDING 으로 남은 수집 행은 실패로 집계 */
WITH c AS (
    SELECT count(*)                                                        AS total_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED')                    AS succ_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('FAILED','RUNNING','PENDING')) AS fail_cnt
      FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
     WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
       AND status <> 'SKIPPED'
)
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
   SET child_total_cnt = c.total_cnt,
       child_succ_cnt  = c.succ_cnt,
       child_fail_cnt  = c.fail_cnt,
       status          = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE 'FAILED' END,
       error_log       = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN m.error_log
                              ELSE '수집 실패 ' || c.fail_cnt || '건 (ctl_ingest_pipeline_run 확인)' || COALESCE(' | ' || m.error_log, '') END,
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
  FROM c
 WHERE m.master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND m.status = 'RUNNING';

/* Fail_master_run : Start_ingest_pipeline Script 실패 시. 수집 이력 INSERT 실패면 같은 문장의 RUNNING 전환도 취소되어 Master 는 PENDING 으로 남아 있음 */
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
   SET status          = 'FAILED',
       child_total_cnt = 0,
       child_succ_cnt  = 0,
       child_fail_cnt  = 0,
       error_log       = left('[Start_ingest_pipeline Script] '
                              || '@{replace(activity('Start_ingest_pipeline Script').error.message, '''', '''''')}', 4000),
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
 WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING');

activities.name: Upd_init_wait_yn
activities.description: INIT_LOAD / FULL_REFRESH 전체 수집 성공 Target -> init_wait_yn = N

text.value:
/* Upd_init_wait_yn : INIT_LOAD / FULL_REFRESH 수집(전체 파일)이 모두 SUCCEEDED 인 Target 의 init_wait_yn 을 N 으로 변경
   대상 : 이 실행(master_run_id)의 수집 이력 중 run_type_cd IN (INIT_LOAD, FULL_REFRESH), SKIPPED 제외
          Target 별로 파티션 행 전체가 SUCCEEDED 일 때만 (하나라도 FAILED / RUNNING / PENDING 이면 유지 = Y)
          PARTIAL_REFRESH 는 전체 수집이 아니므로 제외. 이미 N 인 Target(FULL_REFRESH) 은 변경 없음
   ADF 수집(GEN2 저장) 기준. DBX 적재 결과와 무관. ADF 동적 식은 p 에만 사용. 주석은 블록 주석만 사용 */
WITH p AS (
    SELECT '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text        AS master_run_id,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text  AS created_by
),
t AS (
    SELECT i.target_id
      FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run i
      JOIN p ON p.master_run_id = i.master_run_id
     WHERE i.run_type_cd IN ('INIT_LOAD', 'FULL_REFRESH')
       AND i.status <> 'SKIPPED'
     GROUP BY i.target_id
    HAVING count(*) = count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'SUCCEEDED')
),
u AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m
       SET init_wait_yn = 'N',
           updated_by   = p.created_by,
           updated_dt   = now()
      FROM t, p
     WHERE m.target_id = t.target_id
       AND m.init_wait_yn = 'Y'
       AND m.delete_yn = 'N'
    RETURNING m.target_id
)
SELECT count(*)                                        AS init_done_cnt,
       COALESCE(string_agg(target_id::text, ',' ORDER BY target_id), '') AS init_done_ids
  FROM u;

activities.name: Req_end
activities.description: 재수집 요청 종료 / 기준값 갱신 (REQUEST · FULL_REFRESH). 앞 단계가 모두 끝난 뒤 실행

text.value:
/* pl_raw_orch_init > Script "Req_end" (v8.3 개정, adf_script_v83_request_end.sql)
   End_master_run / Fail_master_run 등 앞 단계가 모두 끝난 뒤 실행. 해당 없는 실행에서는 대상 0건
   A. REQUEST 실행 : 이 실행이 확보한 RUNNING 요청 -> DONE (Target 의 수집 이력 모두 SUCCEEDED) / FAILED. DONE 이면 요청 파티션의 기준값을 요청을 만든 체크 값으로 갱신
   B. FULL_REFRESH 실행 : FULL_REFRESH 수집이 모두 성공한 Target -> FULL 권고(HOLD) DONE, 기준값 교체, 같은 Target 의 PENDING 부분 요청 CANCELED
   ADF 수집(GEN2 저장) 기준. ADF 동적 식은 p 에만 사용. 주석은 블록 주석만 사용 */
WITH p AS (
    SELECT '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text        AS master_run_id,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text  AS created_by
),

/* A. REQUEST 실행 : 이 실행이 확보한 요청 */
req AS (
    SELECT q.*
      FROM adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q JOIN p ON p.master_run_id = q.master_run_id
     WHERE q.status = 'RUNNING'
),

/* Target 별 수집 결과 */
res AS (
    SELECT r.target_id,
           count(i.ingest_pipeline_id)                                       AS total_cnt,
           count(i.ingest_pipeline_id) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'SUCCEEDED') AS succ_cnt
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT target_id FROM req) r
      CROSS JOIN p
      LEFT JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run i
             ON i.master_run_id = p.master_run_id AND i.target_id = r.target_id AND i.status <> 'SKIPPED'
     GROUP BY r.target_id
),

/* 요청 상태 갱신 */
upd AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q
       SET status     = CASE WHEN s.total_cnt > 0 AND s.succ_cnt = s.total_cnt THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'FAILED' END,
           done_dt    = now(),
           error_log  = CASE WHEN s.total_cnt > 0 AND s.succ_cnt = s.total_cnt THEN NULL
                            WHEN s.total_cnt = 0 THEN '수집 이력 없음 (Start_ingest_pipeline Script 실패 확인)'
                            ELSE '수집 실패 ' || (s.total_cnt - s.succ_cnt) || '건 / ' || s.total_cnt || '건' END,
           updated_by = p.created_by,
           updated_dt = now()
      FROM res s, p
     WHERE q.request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM req) AND q.target_id = s.target_id
    RETURNING q.request_id, q.target_id, q.status
),

/* 기준값 대상 : DONE 된 정합성 요청의 파티션 + 그 체크의 값 (Target, 파티션별 최신 요청 1건) */
base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (q.target_id, x.pv)
           q.target_id, x.pv, q.check_run_id, v.row_cnt, v.max_val, v.hash_val,
           (v.row_cnt IS NOT NULL) AS exists_yn
      FROM req q
      JOIN res s ON s.target_id = q.target_id AND s.total_cnt > 0 AND s.succ_cnt = s.total_cnt
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COALESCE(e, '(NULL)') AS pv
                            FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(q.partition_val) e) x
      LEFT JOIN adfadm.ctl_partition_check c
             ON c.master_run_id = q.check_run_id AND c.target_id = q.target_id
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT r.row_cnt, r.max_val, r.hash_val
                           FROM jsonb_to_recordset(c.result_json) AS r(part_key text, row_cnt bigint, max_val text, hash_val text)
                          WHERE COALESCE(r.part_key, '(NULL)') = x.pv) v ON TRUE
     WHERE q.request_src_cd = 'INTEGRITY' AND q.check_run_id IS NOT NULL
     ORDER BY q.target_id, x.pv, q.requested_dt DESC, q.request_id DESC
),

/* B. FULL_REFRESH 실행 : 이 실행에서 FULL_REFRESH 수집이 모두 성공한 Target */
full_tgt AS (
    SELECT i.target_id
      FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run i JOIN p ON p.master_run_id = i.master_run_id
     WHERE i.run_type_cd = 'FULL_REFRESH' AND i.status <> 'SKIPPED'
     GROUP BY i.target_id
    HAVING count(*) = count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'SUCCEEDED')
),

/* 그 Target 의 FULL 권고 중 가장 최근 1건 (기준값 교체용 체크) */
full_hold AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (q.target_id) q.target_id, q.check_run_id, c.result_json, c.check_to_key
      FROM adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q
      JOIN full_tgt f ON f.target_id = q.target_id
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_partition_check c ON c.master_run_id = q.check_run_id AND c.target_id = q.target_id
     WHERE q.status = 'HOLD' AND q.refresh_type_cd = 'FULL_REFRESH' AND q.request_src_cd = 'INTEGRITY'
     ORDER BY q.target_id, q.requested_dt DESC, q.request_id DESC
),

/* FULL 권고 DONE, 부분 재수집 대기 요청 CANCELED */
full_upd AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q
       SET status        = CASE WHEN q.status = 'HOLD' THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'CANCELED' END,
           master_run_id = CASE WHEN q.status = 'HOLD' THEN p.master_run_id ELSE q.master_run_id END,
           done_dt       = CASE WHEN q.status = 'HOLD' THEN now() ELSE q.done_dt END,
           error_log     = CASE WHEN q.status = 'HOLD' THEN NULL
                                ELSE 'FULL_REFRESH 로 대체 (' || p.master_run_id || ')' END,
           updated_by    = p.created_by,
           updated_dt    = now()
      FROM p
     WHERE q.target_id IN (SELECT target_id FROM full_tgt)
       AND q.request_src_cd = 'INTEGRITY'
       AND (   (q.status = 'HOLD' AND q.refresh_type_cd = 'FULL_REFRESH')
            OR (q.status = 'PENDING' AND q.refresh_type_cd = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'))
    RETURNING q.request_id, q.status
),

/* FULL 기준값 : 체크 값 전체 */
full_cur AS (
    SELECT h.target_id, h.check_run_id, h.check_to_key,
           COALESCE(x.part_key, '(NULL)') AS pv, x.row_cnt, x.max_val, x.hash_val
      FROM full_hold h
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(h.result_json) AS x(part_key text, row_cnt bigint, max_val text, hash_val text)
),

/* 기준값 반영 (A + B, Target 이 겹치지 않음) */
base_up AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_partition_state
          (target_id, partition_value, row_cnt, max_val, hash_val, check_run_id, collect_run_id, created_by)
    SELECT b.target_id, b.pv, b.row_cnt, b.max_val, b.hash_val, b.check_run_id, p.master_run_id, p.created_by
      FROM base b CROSS JOIN p
     WHERE b.exists_yn
    UNION ALL
    SELECT f.target_id, f.pv, f.row_cnt, f.max_val, f.hash_val, f.check_run_id, p.master_run_id, p.created_by
      FROM full_cur f CROSS JOIN p
    ON CONFLICT (target_id, partition_value) DO UPDATE
       SET row_cnt = EXCLUDED.row_cnt, max_val = EXCLUDED.max_val, hash_val = EXCLUDED.hash_val,
           check_run_id = EXCLUDED.check_run_id, collect_run_id = EXCLUDED.collect_run_id,
           updated_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, updated_dt = now()
    RETURNING target_id
),
base_del AS (
    DELETE FROM adfadm.ctl_partition_state s
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM base b
                    WHERE NOT b.exists_yn AND s.target_id = b.target_id AND s.partition_value = b.pv)
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM full_hold h
                    WHERE h.target_id = s.target_id
                      AND (   h.check_to_key IS NULL OR s.partition_value = '(NULL)'
                           OR s.partition_value COLLATE "C" < h.check_to_key COLLATE "C")
                      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM full_cur f
                                       WHERE f.target_id = s.target_id AND f.pv = s.partition_value))
    RETURNING s.target_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM upd)                              AS request_cnt,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM upd WHERE status = 'DONE')        AS done_cnt,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM upd WHERE status = 'FAILED')      AS failed_cnt,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM full_upd WHERE status = 'DONE')   AS full_done_cnt,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM full_upd WHERE status = 'CANCELED') AS full_canceled_cnt,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM base_up)                          AS state_upsert_cnt,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM base_del)                         AS state_delete_cnt;
